title: What 'coon' means in the song
summary: Allen asks the meaning of the word in the song and Love says it means a big black man.

blocks.x: Before I forget it, I don't think we put on the tape in that hoodoo song. You say, I've been hoodooed by a big black coon.
That means big black man. Mm-hmm. Big black man.
